verses.text: Ayik ix te k'ib' sb'isul heb' anima t'a sat lu'um tik, ay pax yisil heb' winh winak ix alji.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal Dios, ayik ix yilan heb' ix yisil heb' anima chi' heb' winh, te wach' yilji heb' ix, ix laj sik'lan heb' winh machtak heb' ix syik' heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová: Manhxo ol wak' sk'inal heb' anima tik yuj spital. Chamelb'a anima yaj heb', yuj chi' haxonhej 120 ab'il olto ek' heb' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, xchi.
Ayik ix b'eykot tiempo, ix yik'lan sb'a heb' winh yuninal Dios yet' heb' ix yisil heb' anima chi', haxo yuninal heb' skuch Nefilim. Ha heb' chi' te tek'an heb', te b'inajnak heb' t'a pekatax chi'.
Ix yilan Jehová to yelk'olal sk'ib' schukal heb' anima t'a sat lu'um tik, to haxonhej tas malaj swach'il ayek' t'a spensar heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yala': Oktom maj in b'olaj juntzanh anima tik. Te ya swab' yuj heb'.

Ol in satel juntzanh anima ix in b'o t'a sat lu'um tik yet' pax nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' k'ultakil nok' yet' nok' tzek' nhernhonok ma tzek' jachjon t'a sat lu'um yet' pax nok' much. Ste tak wal in k'o'ol yujto ix in b'o masanil juntzanh tik, xchi Dios.
Anhej wal winhaj Noé wach' t'a yichanh Jehová.

Haton yab'ixal winhaj Noé tik: Ha winhaj Noé chi', te wach' ix yutej sb'a winh t'a yichanh Dios, anhej winh wach' spensar t'a skal heb' anima t'a jun pekti' chi'. Ix sb'eyb'alej winh icha snib'ej Dios.
Ay oxwanh yuninal winh, haton winhaj Sem, winhaj Cam yet' winhaj Jafet.
Haxo heb' anima, ix te chukb'i heb' t'a yichanh Dios, komonxonhej syixtej yetanimail heb', smil-lajcham sb'a heb'.
Ix yilan Dios to masanil anima ix te juwieli, haxonhej ixtoj anima sk'ulej heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yal Dios t'a winhaj Noé chi': Toxo ix in na' to ol in satel masanil anima tik. Yujto haxonhej ixtoj anima sk'ulej heb', yuj chi' ol in satel heb' yet' masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Ha tiknaik, tza b'o junok te' niwan barco. Ha te te' ay stzatajil, a te' tzak'och ste'alok te'. Makkiltak tzutej yo'ol te', wach' tzutej ak'anoch tzataj chi' b'aj snub'laj sb'a te'. Tzak'och t'a spatik yet' t'a yo'ol, yik wach' malaj b'aj ol och ha' t'a yol te'.
135 metro tzutej sk'atul te', 22 metro yet' nanhalxo tzutej sat te', 13 metro yet' nanhalxo ste'el te'.
Oxe' piso tzutej te'. Haxo t'a sjajk'ek'och te', hata' skan jakan smasanil, nanhal metro tz'ajkan scha'anhil, skanpax junok spuertail t'a junok pak'anh.
Yujto ol wak'kot jun owal ha' yik smukan sat lu'um tik, ol b'ut'jokkanel yuj ha', haxo satel jantak tas syik' yik' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Anhej het'ok tzin b'okan jun in trato tik. Ha t'a yol te' niwan barco chi' ol ach ochkan yet' ix etb'eyum, heb' uninal yet' pax heb' ix alib'.
Ol ochpax nok' nok' heyet'ok, junjun mojanh nok' t'a junjun makan ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, yik wach' ol kolchajkan nok' heyet'ok.
Chatakwanh nok' t'a junjun makan tz'ochkani: Nok' much, nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' k'ultakil nok' yet' nok' tzek' nhernhonok ma tzek' jachjon t'a sat lu'um, yik wach' manh ol satel nok'.
Ol a molankanoch jantak tas ol wajok, yik wach' ay tas tze wa yet' tas swa nok', xchi Dios t'a winhaj Noé chi'.
Ix sk'anab'ajan winhaj Noé chi' masanil tas ix yal Dios.
